'Play the latest video' maps to the top-relevance result; true upload-date sorting would require interacting with the site's filter UI
Search-result clicking requires either Playwright (DOM tier) or a browser exposing an accessibility tree (AT-SPI tier); with xdg-open only, Laya reports an honest failure instead of guessing
The laya neural router runs in parser-only fallback when the Convai model is unavailable (by design, honest degradation)
